title: Pour a drink
brief:
Pick up the pitcher and pour until the cup is at least **80% full**, then put the pitcher back down **upright**.

Tilting the tool past 90° pours. With the gripper pointing down (`rx: 180`), setting `rx: -70` tilts the pitcher toward −y, so its spout moves about 56 mm toward −y. `cup.above` is already offset for you.
